items.title: Neutrophil to Lymphocyte Ratio as a Biomarker of Severity in Myasthenia Gravis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
items.authors: Pricilla Yani Gunawan, Yang Yang Endro Arjuna, Alexander Erick Purnomo
items.abstract: Introduction With its increasing prevalence, myasthenia gravis requires reliable prognostic tools. Neutrophil-lymphocte ratio (NLR) offers a simple inflammatory marker to aid early risk evaluation. This meta-analysis aimed to clarify the role of NLR in predicting MG outcomes to support earlier clinical risk stratification. Methods A comprehensive search of PubMed, ScienceDirect, Google Scholar, and Europe PMC were conducted from inception to November 2025. Studies were included if they compared NLR between MG patients and controls or evaluated its prognostic value, while nonclinical research, case reports, reviews, conference abstracts, and non-English papers were excluded. Secondary outcomes were other inflammatory measures, such as white blood cell counts, blood cell differentials, platelet-lymphocyte ratio (PLR), and lymphocyte-monocyte ratio (LMR). Methodological quality was assessed using the QUADAS-2 tool. Results Seven retrospective cohort studies including 1,526 participants were evaluated. Patients with MG had significantly increased white blood cell counts [WMD 1.00 (95% CI: 0.63-1.37; I² = 0%)], neutrophil counts [MD 0.75 (95% CI: 0.15-1.36; I² = 0%)], and NLR values [MD 0.52 (95% CI: 0.07-0.96; I² = 63%)]. No consistent differences were observed in lymphocyte or monocyte counts. Platelet levels were similar, though PLR was generally higher and LMR lower in MG patients. Diagnostic analysis demonstrated that NLR reliably predicted severe MG, with pooled sensitivity of 0.82, specificity of 0.71, and AUC of 0.85. Conclusions NLR is associated with disease severity in MG. NLR may serve as a simple, accessible, and cost-effective marker for disease activity.
items.zhSummary: 本系统综述和Meta分析旨在评估中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比率（NLR）在重症肌无力（MG）疾病严重性中的预测价值。通过检索多个数据库，纳入7项回顾性队列研究，共1526名参与者。结果显示MG患者白细胞计数、中性粒细胞计数及NLR显著升高，PLR较高，LMR较低，而淋巴细胞和单核细胞计数无一致差异。NLR对重症MG的诊断表现较好，敏感性和特异性分别为0.82和0.71，AUC为0.85。该指标可能作为简便、经济的炎症标志物用于疾病活动性评估。研究局限于回顾性设计且存在部分异质性，需进一步验证。

items.title: Integrated Multi-Omics Profiling of Thymoma Identifies Subtype-Specific Remodeling and Myasthenia Gravis-Associated Targets.
items.authors: Yaohui Sun, Jianfeng Mao, Xueqian Sun, Wanwei Cao, Jian Liu, Guihong Zhang
items.abstract: Thymoma is a rare thymic epithelial tumor strongly associated with myasthenia gravis (MG), yet the tumor intrinsic molecular states underlying this link remain unclear. Here, we profiled paired thymoma and distant nontumorous thymic tissues using untargeted metabolomics, lipidomics, and label-free quantitative proteomics, integrating these layers with MG status, clinicopathologic data, immunohistochemistry, and external transcriptomic validation from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) cohort. Thymomas exhibited a reproducible metabolic and lipidomic signature characterized by coordinated alterations in amino acid and nucleotide metabolism alongside structured changes in lipid subclasses that support membrane remodeling. Proteomic profiling distinguished tumors from distant nontumorous thymic tissue and identified three exploratory proteomic groups with distinct pathway patterns tightly coupled to lipid metabolic shifts. Integrated analyses identified HMGCS1 and SCP2 as subtype-enriched, lipid-linked hubs and uncovered an MG-associated molecular module comprising creatine, MePC(37:4), ACP5, AP1S1, NECTIN4, and fatty acid pathways. AP1S1 showed an independent association with the overall survival in the TCGA thymoma cohort. A derived 13-lipid panel showed high discrimination in an internal evaluation, supporting its potential as a candidate signature for further validation. This tissue-based multi-omics study systematically maps coordinated molecular remodeling in thymoma, highlighting HMGCS1, SCP2, and AP1S1 as prioritized candidates for future mechanistic and translational research.
items.zhSummary: 本研究针对胸腺瘤这一罕见胚胎上皮肿瘤及其与重症肌无力（MG）的关联，采用代谢组学、脂质组学和无标记定量蛋白质组学等多组学方法，结合MG状态、临床病理资料和免疫组织化学进行综合分析，并使用TCGA转录组数据进行验证。结果显示胸腺瘤在氨基酸、核苷酸代谢及脂质亚类上呈现协调性变化，蛋白质组分析识别出三类具有不同脂质代谢通路特征的亚型，并发现HMGCS1、SCP2在亚型中特异表达。研究还揭示了一个与MG相关的分子模块及与总体生存独立相关的AP1S1。研究建立的13种脂质组合在内部评估中表现出较高鉴别力。该研究系统绘制了胸腺瘤的分子重塑图谱，为未来的机制及转化研究提供候选标靶。

items.title: Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living Deep Phenotyping and Longitudinal.
items.journal: medRxiv : the preprint server for health sciences
items.authors: Marc Garbey, Quentin Lesport, Olivia Haddad, Charles Carpenter, Henry J Kaminski
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis clinical trials increasingly rely on the MG Activities of Daily Living total score to assess disease severity and treatment response. However, aggregate scores may obscure clinically meaningful changes in individual symptom domains. To determine whether item-level MG-Activities of Daily Living profiles identify distinct clinical phenotypes and whether longitudinal phenotype transitions reveal disease changes inadequately captured by aggregate scores. MG-Activities of Daily Living evaluations from seven clinical trials and observational studies (5,259 observations were analyzed using principal component analysis and K-medoids clustering with Cityblock distance. Longitudinal phenotype transitions were evaluated in the three longitudinal cohorts and compared with changes in total scores. Despite low median MG-ADL scores (2.0-3.0), substantial intercohort symptom heterogeneity was observed. Clustering identified five phenotypes: mild ocular (23.7%), severe ocular-dominant (23.5%), bulbar-respiratory dominant (22.6%), severe generalized (16.0%), and proximal limb-axial weakness (14.3%). Longitudinal phenotype instability occurred in 38-49% of Explore participants, 47-49% of Promise participants, and 20-25% of MGTX participants. Importantly, clinically meaningful phenotype transitions, including shifts from ocular to bulbar predominance, frequently occurred with changes of only one point in total MG-ADL scores. Conversely, substantial total score fluctuations could occur without a change in phenotype. MG-ADL total scores incompletely characterize disease heterogeneity and longitudinal symptom evolution. Incorporating item-level phenotyping into clinical trials and routine care may improve interpretation of treatment response, identify clinically important deterioration overlooked by aggregate scores, and facilitate more precise assessment of disease trajectories.
items.zhSummary: 本研究基于七个临床试验和观察队列中5259个重症肌无力日常生活活动（MG-ADL）评分数据，采用主成分分析和聚类方法识别了五种临床表型，并评估了纵向队列中表型的变动。结果显示尽管总评分较低，但症状表现具有显著异质性，表型间存在多样变化，且临床上重要的表型转变未必反映在总评分变化中。研究提示MG-ADL总评分无法充分描述疾病异质性及其动态变化，建议临床试验和日常管理中加入项目级表型分析以更准确解读治疗反应和疾病进程。摘要未提及研究局限。
keyPoints: MG-ADL总分难以揭示各种症状域的具体变化
通过聚类分析鉴别五种重症肌无力临床表型
表型变化频繁且不完全对应总评分波动
纳入项目级表型有助于更准确评价疾病进展

items.title: Postoperative Neuromuscular Paresis and Overlap Syndrome Related to Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors: A Case Report.
items.authors: Barlas Goker, Ilem Karaca, Andrew Johns, Jean-Bernard Durand, Joseph Nates, Robert L Satcher
items.abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) can cause rare, severe immune-related adverse events. ICI-related overlap syndrome of myositis, myocarditis, and myasthenia gravis (3M) is uncommon yet carries high morbidity and mortality. We report a case with postoperative ICI-induced 3M syndrome that developed extremity paresis following proximal humerus resection and reconstruction. His clinical course was complicated by respiratory failure and septic shock, requiring intensive care. He was treated with intravenous immunoglobulin, corticosteroids, and plasmapheresis, leading to gradual recovery. This case highlights a rare postoperative presentation of 3M syndrome and underscores the importance of early recognition and prompt management.

items.title: Antigen-driven CD8+ T cell activation drives the immunopathogenesis of myasthenia gravis-associated myocarditis.
items.authors: Hongxi Chen, Nana Zhang, Ziyan Shi, Ying Zhang, Qin Du, Rui Wang
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis-associated myocarditis (MG-myocarditis) is a life-threatening condition. However, the immune dysregulation underlying its pathogenesis remains poorly defined. This study aimed to delineate the immunological pathways driving myocarditis development in patients with MG. We performed integrated single-cell RNA sequencing and paired T cell receptor (TCR) repertoire profiling on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) from 3 patients with MG-myocarditis and 4 patients with MG-only. Analyses were conducted to characterize transcriptional states, differentiation trajectories, clonal expansions, and antigen-specific signatures associated with MG-myocarditis. Although the overall proportions of major PBMC lineages did not differ significantly between groups, transcriptomic profiling revealed substantial numbers of significantly differentially expressed genes across multiple immune cell subsets. Classical CD14+ monocytes displayed a marked skewing toward a pro-inflammatory differentiation trajectory, accompanied by downregulation of the Activator Protein-1-high intermediate state associated with anti-inflammatory programming. Within the T cell compartment, MG-myocarditis was characterized by robust expansion of TCR clonotypes concurrently enriched in CD8+ effector memory with high EOMES expression and CD8+ effector subsets, indicative of recent or ongoing antigen-driven activation.TCR-peptide binding prediction analysis showed preferential reactivity of these expanded clonotypes toward cardiac proteins-including Titin, MYO10, and MYH6-implicating antigen-specific cytotoxicity in myocardial injury. In parallel, non-classical CD16+ monocytes and conventional dendritic cells (cDCs) exhibited enhanced antigen-presenting signatures, marked respectively by S100A8 upregulation and LY6E downregulation. Our findings identify non-classical CD16+ monocytes and cDCs as potential cardiac antigen-presenting populations capable of priming pathogenic CD8+ T cell responses, thereby contributing to the immunopathogenesis of MG-associated myocarditis.
items.zhSummary: 本研究通过单细胞RNA测序和T细胞受体谱分析，探讨重症肌无力相关心肌炎（MG-myocarditis）的免疫机制。研究对象包括3例MG-myocarditis患者和4例仅患有MG的患者。结果显示，MG-myocarditis患者的CD8+效应记忆及效应T细胞群体出现显著克隆扩增，且这些T细胞受体显示针对心脏蛋白的特异性反应，同时非经典CD16+单核细胞和常规树突状细胞表现出增强的抗原呈递特征。研究揭示了抗原驱动的CD8+ T细胞活化及相关抗原呈递细胞在MG-myocarditis发病中的作用。摘要未涉及样本量限制或该机制的临床验证。

items.title: Conversion of VA-to-VV ECMO modes in the management of severe community-acquired pneumonia complicated by septic shock: A case report.
items.journal: Journal of infection and public health
items.authors: Haoran Hu, Xinkai Qiu, Weiguo Zhang, Huanhuan Tian, Bingjie Lv, Tao Wang
items.abstract: In the post-pandemic era, there has been a notable increase in the incidence of community-acquired pneumonia (CAP), with an earlier age of onset and more severe clinical symptoms. A subset of these patients requires extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) support, either alone or in combination, to maintain hemodynamic and respiratory stability. This paper discusses a case study of a previously healthy middle-aged male who developed severe CAP due to Klebsiella pneumoniae (Kp), escalating to septic shock. During his hospitalization, the patient experienced a range of complications, such as septic shock, septic cardiomyopathy, acute kidney injury, lung abscess, empyema, pyopneumothorax, gastrointestinal bleeding, intestinal obstruction, and acquired myasthenia gravis. After undergoing a six-month multidisciplinary treatment regimen that included venoarterial (VA)-venovenous (VV) ECMO mode conversion, invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV), and continuous blood purification (CBP), the patient eventually demonstrated clinical improvement. This case report emphasizes the clinical characteristics and management challenges associated with severe CAP and its life-threatening complications, aiming to provide insights into effective therapeutic strategies.

items.title: Probable Seronegative Myasthenia Gravis With Initially Negative Diagnostic Testing: A Case Report.
items.authors: Sandra Rodrigues, Francisco Dias
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis (MG) is an autoimmune disorder of the neuromuscular junction characterized by fluctuating, fatigable weakness. Diagnosis can be particularly challenging when symptoms are initially non-specific and standard serological and neurophysiological investigations are unrevealing. We report the case of a 27-year-old woman who initially developed progressive fatigue and exercise intolerance, followed by fluctuating left eyelid ptosis that worsened with exertion and improved with rest. Initial laboratory testing and cranial imaging were unrevealing. Persistence and progression of ocular symptoms prompted neurological assessment, during which an ice-pack test produced clear improvement in ptosis. Anti-acetylcholine receptor, anti-muscle-specific kinase, and anti-low-density lipoprotein receptor-related protein 4 antibodies were negative, thoracic imaging excluded thymoma, and single-fiber electromyography of the orbicularis oculi was normal, providing no objective electrophysiological confirmation of MG. A trial of pyridostigmine provided only limited symptomatic benefit. In the context of the characteristic fluctuating phenotype, positive bedside test, exclusion of relevant alternative diagnoses, and despite the absence of objective electrophysiological confirmation, a working diagnosis of probable seronegative MG (SNMG) was established, and immunosuppressive treatment was initiated. Over the following two years, symptoms generalized, with limb fatigability, difficulty climbing stairs, occasional dysphagia, and substantial functional limitation. This case highlights the diagnostic uncertainty inherent to suspected SNMG and the importance of longitudinal clinical assessment. Negative antibody and neurophysiological results should prompt careful reassessment and consideration of mimics rather than automatic exclusion or confirmation of MG. In primary care, recognizing true muscle fatigability, diurnal fluctuation, and evolving focal signs may facilitate timely specialist evaluation.
items.zhSummary: 本文报告了一例27岁女性疑似血清阴性的重症肌无力（SNMG）病例，初始诊断检测（抗体检测、电生理和影像学）均未发现异常。患者表现为波动性乏力和左侧上睑下垂，冰敷试验阳性，试用吡啶斯的明症状改善有限。排除其它疾病后依据临床表现给予免疫抑制治疗，随访两年出现症状加重和全身性疲劳。该病例体现了SNMG诊断的复杂性，强调了纵向临床评估的重要性，并提示阴性抗体和电生理结果应促使重新评估和鉴别诊断。
keyPoints: 重症肌无力可出现血清阴性且电生理正常的病例

items.title: Circulating GFAP and Neurofilament Light Chain in Myasthenia Gravis: A Preliminary Exploratory Case Series.
items.authors: Aurora Zanghì, Paola Sofia Di Filippo, Emanuele D'Amico
items.abstract: Glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) and neurofilament light chain (NfL) are circulating biomarkers reflecting astroglial activation and axonal injury. While these markers have been extensively investigated in neurodegenerative and neuroinflammatory diseases, their relevance in autoimmune neuromuscular disorders such as myasthenia gravis (MG) remains unclear. A preliminary, exploratory, cross-sectional case series of 7 patients with confirmed MG was conducted. Serum GFAP and NfL concentrations were measured using ultrasensitive assays. Within-cohort relationships between biomarkers, clinical severity scores, and age were summarized using Spearman correlation analysis and exploratory age-adjusted linear models, interpreted descriptively rather than as confirmatory hypothesis tests. Individual biomarker values were also benchmarked descriptively against published age-stratified serum upper reference limits derived from healthy adults. In this cohort, GFAP and NfL levels showed a high positive within-cohort correlation (p = 0.93, p = 0.002). No clear relationship with the MG Activities of Daily Living scale or Quantitative MG clinical scores was observed, although the sample size precludes exclusion of clinically meaningful associations. Age showed positive associations with both GFAP (β = 0.51, p = 0.039) and NfL levels (β = 0.56, p = 0.049), consistent with the known age dependence of these biomarkers. Compared with the published external age-stratified limits, GFAP was below the relevant threshold in all seven participants, whereas NfL exceeded it in four of seven (57.1%); among the four participants within the 18-69-year age range, two exceeded the NfL limit. In this preliminary exploratory cohort of patients with MG, circulating GFAP and NfL showed a high within-cohort correlation. Because of the very small sample size, absence of controls, and heterogeneous treatment exposure, these findings should be interpreted as descriptive and hypothesis-generating. External benchmarking showed a discordant descriptive pattern for NfL and GFAP, but it cannot establish MG-specific biomarker abnormality because the reference cohort was not assay-matched and 3 participants were outside its age range. Simultaneous measurement of serum GFAP and NfL was feasible in this small MG cohort. Larger, controlled, longitudinal studies are required to determine whether these biomarkers provide disease-specific or clinically meaningful information in MG. The external benchmark was descriptive only and requires confirmation using contemporaneous age-matched controls and an assay-matched platform.
items.zhSummary: 本研究通过一项初步、探索性、横断面病例系列，测定了7例重症肌无力（MG）患者血清中星形胶质酸性蛋白（GFAP）和神经丝轻链（NfL）浓度，评估其与临床严重程度及年龄的关系。结果显示GFAP与NfL水平在队列内高度正相关，但未见明显与临床评分相关，限制包括样本量极小、无对照组及治疗异质性。与已发表健康成人年龄分层参考值对比，GFAP均低于阈值，NfL则有部分患者超标。结论为测定GFAP和NfL可行，但需更大规模、对照及纵向研究验证其MG特异性及临床价值。

items.title: Real-world clinical effectiveness and exploratory longitudinal immunological changes of Efgartigimod in myasthenia gravis: a retrospective study and a single-cell analysis in one patient.
items.authors: Jingnan Jin, Xia Wang, Zihong Chen, Lukuan Qiao, Qingling Guo, Yan Li
items.abstract: Efgartigimod, an antagonist of the neonatal Fc receptor, has demonstrated efficacy in generalized myasthenia gravis, but evidence from routine clinical practice remains limited, and its immunological effects beyond immunoglobulin G reduction are incompletely understood. We retrospectively evaluated the 12-week effectiveness and safety of Efgartigimod in 21 patients with acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis. Outcomes included changes in Myasthenia Gravis Activities of Daily Living scores, response rates defined by reductions of ≥2 and ≥5 points, achievement of minimal symptom expression, changes in prednisone dosage, and adverse events. To explore potential longer-term immune changes, paired peripheral blood mononuclear cell samples obtained from one patient at baseline and after 6 months of repeated treatment were analyzed using single-cell RNA sequencing and T- and B-cell receptor repertoire sequencing. The median MG-ADL score decreased from 7.0 (IQR, 6.0-8.0) at baseline to 1.0 (IQR, 1.0-1.5) at week 12. After the first and second treatment cycles, 85.7 and 94.7% of patients achieved CMI, respectively, while 57.1 and 84.2% achieved ≥5-point reductions. At week 12, 73.7% of patients achieved MSE. Treatment was generally well tolerated, with two mild adverse events and no serious adverse events. Exploratory longitudinal profiling in one patient identified reduced myeloid inflammatory activity and antigen-presentation signatures, attenuated predicted inflammatory intercellular communication, and a more dispersed pattern of T- and B-cell clonal expansion after prolonged treatment. The clinical cohort findings support the effectiveness and favorable safety profile of Efgartigimod in routine practice. The exploratory single-cell and immune repertoire analyses from one patient provide preliminary insights into potential immunological changes beyond IgG reduction and require validation in larger cohorts.
items.zhSummary: 本研究回顾性分析了21例乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性广泛型重症肌无力患者，评估Efgartigimod在12周的临床效果和安全性。通过日常生活活动评分（MG-ADL）变化、反应率及激素用量变化评价疗效，结果显示MG-ADL中位数由7降至1，较大比例患者达到显著症状缓解。安全性良好，仅有轻微不良事件。对一例患者进行单细胞和免疫受体组学分析，发现除IgG减少外可能存在免疫调节变化，但需更多样本验证。

大部分患者达到最小症状表达且无严重不良事件
单细胞分析显示长期用药可调节髓系炎症和免疫细胞克隆扩展

items.title: Clinical and bone-turnover outcomes associated with topical herbal plaster adjunctive therapy in older patients with myasthenia gravis and glucocorticoid-associated osteoporotic fragility fracture: a retrospective cohort study with exploratory peripheral-blood BMP-2/Smad/Runx2 analysis.
items.authors: Qing Pan, Wei Wei, Chengjie Tang
items.abstract: Elderly patients with myasthenia gravis (MG) frequently require prolonged glucocorticoid therapy and may develop glucocorticoid-associated osteoporosis and fragility fracture. Post-fracture recovery in this population may be complicated by neuromuscular weakness, fall risk, impaired bone remodeling, fracture-site pain, and limited tolerance of systemic analgesic therapy. Xiaotong plaster is a topical external therapy used for musculoskeletal pain and swelling, but evidence for its adjunctive use after osteoporotic fracture in elderly patients with MG remains limited. This study evaluated the association between Xiaotong plaster adjunctive external treatment and 12-week fracture-site pain in elderly MG patients with glucocorticoid-associated osteoporotic fragility fracture. Bone-turnover and inflammatory outcomes were assessed as secondary exploratory endpoints, and BMP-2/Smad/Runx2-related changes were evaluated as hypothesis-generating mechanistic signals. These peripheral-blood measurements were treated as exploratory correlates and not as evidence that the topical plaster activated an osteogenic pathway at the fracture site. Consecutive patients aged 60 years or older with confirmed MG, systemic glucocorticoid exposure for at least 3 months, and radiologically confirmed osteoporotic fragility fracture were retrospectively screened at a tertiary medical center between January 2021 and December 2025. Patients receiving standard anti-osteoporosis treatment alone were compared with those receiving standard treatment plus Xiaotong plaster within 4 weeks after fracture. The primary outcome was fracture-site pain change from baseline to 12 weeks. Secondary and biomarker outcomes were considered exploratory. Propensity score weighting was used to reduce measured baseline imbalance, with doubly robust and sensitivity analyses used to examine the robustness of the primary association. Treatment allocation was observational and unblinded; no placebo plaster was used. A total of 168 patients were included, including 86 receiving standard treatment alone and 82 receiving standard treatment plus Xiaotong plaster. The adjusted between-group difference in 12-week pain change was -10.2 mm on the 0-100 mm scale (95% CI, -13.8 to -6.6; P < 0.001). P1NP increased more in the adjunctive-treatment group (adjusted difference, 10.2 ng/mL; 95% CI, 6.8 to 13.6; P < 0.001), while β-CTX decreased modestly more (adjusted difference, -0.045 ng/mL; 95% CI, -0.087 to -0.003; P = 0.035). Six-month radiographic healing (P = 0.711), delayed union or nonunion (P = 0.363), 12-month new fragility fracture (P = 0.083), lumbar spine BMD change (P = 0.177), and MG exacerbation (P = 0.692) did not differ significantly after adjustment. In the exploratory subgroup, p-Smad1/5/8 (P = 0.001) and Runx2 (P = 0.002) increased more in the adjunctive-treatment group, whereas BMP-2 change was not significant (P = 0.449). The biomarker signal was therefore confined to downstream p-Smad1/5/8 and Runx2 rather than BMP-2 itself. One exposed patient permanently discontinued the plaster because of contact dermatitis. Xiaotong plaster adjunctive treatment was associated with greater short-term fracture-site pain reduction and exploratory changes in bone-turnover markers in elderly MG patients with glucocorticoid-associated osteoporotic fragility fracture. The study did not demonstrate improvement in fracture healing, BMD, or recurrent fracture, and the peripheral-blood BMP-2/Smad/Runx2 findings should be interpreted as hypothesis-generating rather than evidence of a causal osteogenic mechanism. Human transdermal pharmacokinetic exposure was not measured, so systemic pathway activation cannot be inferred from these data.
items.zhSummary: 本研究回顾性分析了老年重症肌无力患者中应用小通贴敷剂辅助治疗对糖皮质激素相关骨质疏松性脆性骨折骨痛及骨代谢指标的影响。纳入168例≥60岁确诊MG且长期使用糖皮质激素并发生脆性骨折患者，比较标准抗骨质疏松治疗与联合小通贴治疗后的骨折部位12周疼痛变化及骨代谢、生物标志物指标。结果显示，贴敷组疼痛减轻更明显，骨形成标志物P1NP升高，骨吸收标志物β-CTX轻微下降，但骨折愈合率、骨密度、骨折复发及MG恶化无显著差异。BMP-2/Smad/Runx2血液标志物变化具有探索性假设价值，未证明因果机制。研究为观察性，未盲法，无安慰剂，对贴敷剂皮肤不良反应个别发生。

items.title: Exacerbations and crises in generalized myasthenia gravis: predictors and associated economic burden in the United States.
items.authors: Kavita Grover, Martin Cloutier, Geoffroy Coteur, Porpong Boonmak, Antoine C El Khoury, Maryia Zhdanava
items.abstract: The management of exacerbations and crises (clinical events) in generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG) patients is resource-intensive. Identifying characteristics associated with increased risk for these events may help optimize allocation of preventative strategies. This study identified baseline predictors of a first clinical event following diagnosis and assessed the burden of these events among patients with gMG in the United States. A newly diagnosed cohort of adults with gMG were identified from Komodo Research Database (01/2017-09/2023) with an index date at the first gMG diagnosis made by a neurologist. Baseline demographics, comorbidities, gMG-related treatments, healthcare resource utilization (HRU) and costs were described; patients were followed until first clinical event or censoring at end of follow-up. A multivariable Cox proportional hazards model assessed baseline predictors of the first clinical event. Among patients with ≥12 months of follow-up, cohorts with and without a clinical event during follow-up were created; index date was the first clinical event or a random date, respectively. Cohorts were re-weighted using entropy balancing. HRU and costs during 12 months post-index were compared. Among 6,195 patients with gMG (mean age: 61.1 years; female: 49.1%), higher event risk was associated with use of immunoglobulin [hazard ratio (HR) = 1.54], baseline dysarthria (HR = 1.45), general and other muscle-specific weaknesses (HR = 1.38), use of non-steroidal immunosuppressants (HR = 1.37), dysphagia (HR = 1.28), weight loss (HR=1.27), dyspnea (HR = 1.23), ptosis (HR = 1.20), absence of other autoimmune disorders (HR=1.18), and male sex (HR = 1.15; all p < 0.05). In the cohort, 2,657 had a clinical event, while 3,092 did not; all had ≥12 months of follow-up after index. After re-weighting, patients with a clinical event had higher number of inpatient admissions [rate ratio (RR) = 6.02], emergency visits (RR = 1.91), and outpatient visits (RR = 1.58; all p < 0.05) in the 12 months post-index. Mean total healthcare costs were $70,792 higher among patients with a clinical event ($95,821 vs. $25,029, p < 0.001), driven by immunoglobulin and inpatient costs. Disease severity and immunosuppressive therapy use were associated with increased risk of exacerbations and crises, which imposed substantial HRU and cost burden. Findings may help identify candidates who could benefit from earlier or more advanced therapies to prevent acute clinical events.
items.zhSummary: 本研究基于美国Komodo研究数据库，回顾性队列分析了6195例新诊断广泛性重症肌无力（gMG）成人患者，旨在识别首次临床事件（病情加重或危象）的基线预测因素，并评估这些事件带来的医疗资源使用及经济负担。结果显示，免疫球蛋白使用、言语障碍、肌无力、多发免疫抑制剂治疗等与事件风险增加相关。经权重调整后，发生临床事件患者的住院、急诊及门诊次数均显著增多，且12个月内总医疗费用比无事件患者高出约7万美元，差异主要来源于免疫球蛋白及住院费用。研究提示疾病严重度和免疫抑制治疗与事件风险相关，且加重了医疗负担。因数据来自数据库，存在一定的局限性。

items.title: When imaging misleads: Severe bulbar myasthenia gravis with a concomitant tectal lesion: A case report.
items.authors: Kleber Orlando Mosquera Rodriguez, María de Los Ángeles Álvarez Falcón, Juan Carlos Moreira Holguín, Lina Karitza Zambrano Chang
items.abstract: Myasthenia gravis (MG) may present with prominent oculobulbar symptoms overlapping with structural brainstem disorders, creating a diagnostic challenge when neuroimaging reveals a potentially explanatory lesion. We report generalized MG with severe bulbar involvement and a concomitant tectal lesion. A 23-year-old woman with autoimmune thyroiditis presented with a 4-5-month history of ptosis, diplopia, dysarthria, nasal speech, dysphagia, proximal weakness, fatigability, and episodic dyspnea. Examination revealed fatigable bilateral ptosis, facial and masticatory weakness, severe bulbar dysfunction, bilateral tongue weakness with fasciculations, cervical weakness, and symmetric proximal limb weakness, without sensory, cerebellar, or pyramidal abnormalities. Brain magnetic resonance imaging demonstrated a small left tectal fluid-attenuated inversion recovery-hyperintense lesion without contrast enhancement or significant mass effect, initially suggesting a low-grade structural lesion. However, the extensive bilateral, fluctuating, and fatigable syndrome was discordant with this finding. Anti-acetylcholine receptor antibodies were positive (2.48 nmol/L), supporting generalized MG. Treatment with pyridostigmine, corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulin, and azathioprine produced progressive improvement. One year later, a respiratory infection precipitated a myasthenic crisis requiring intensive care, followed by recovery. At follow-up, she remained stable without dysphagia or dyspnea, while the tectal lesion was managed conservatively. This case highlights the risk of diagnostic anchoring on neuroimaging abnormalities. Careful clinicoradiological correlation, particularly recognition of anatomical discordance and fatigability, is essential before attributing a complex bulbar syndrome to a structural brainstem lesion.
items.zhSummary: 本文报告一例23岁女性伴自身免疫性甲状腺炎的广泛型重症肌无力，表现为严重的球部功能障碍，同时脑部影像发现左侧四叠体小病灶。临床表现与影像所示结构病变不符，血清抗乙酰胆碱受体抗体阳性，支持广泛型重症肌无力诊断。经抗胆碱酯酶药物、糖皮质激素、静脉免疫球蛋白和硫唑嘌呤治疗后症状改善。随访中一度呼吸感染诱发肌无力危象，治疗后恢复稳定，脑部病灶采用保守管理。该病例提示神经影像异常可能误导诊断，临床与影像的详细相关性分析对鉴别重症肌无力与结构性脑干病变至关重要。

items.title: Baseline severity and early tacrolimus trough are associated with time to minimal manifestations in steroid-free tacrolimus monotherapy for AChR antibody-positive myasthenia gravis.
items.authors: T Uchi, S Konno
items.abstract: Tacrolimus is used as an immunosuppressive treatment for myasthenia gravis (MG), and monotherapy without corticosteroids may be feasible in selected patients. Still, what determines how quickly patients reach minimal manifestations (MM) under this approach has not been well characterized. To examine the time course to MM achievement and to investigate whether baseline disease severity and early tacrolimus trough concentration are associated with the time to MM achievement in acetylcholine receptor (AChR) antibody-positive MG. This single-center retrospective cohort study included 30 AChR antibody-positive MG patients who started tacrolimus monotherapy (3mg/day) within 1-3months after onset, without oral corticosteroids or early additional non-oral immunomodulatory treatments. These additional treatments included intravenous methylprednisolone pulse therapy, intravenous immunoglobulin, plasmapheresis, and molecular targeted therapies. The primary outcome was the time from tacrolimus initiation to first MM achievement. Clinical courses were compared between ocular MG (OMG) and generalized MG (GMG) using the Kaplan-Meier method. A Cox proportional hazards model stratified by baseline phenotype was used for the main analysis. Exploratory quartile-based Kaplan-Meier curves were also generated according to early tacrolimus trough concentration. Overall, 26 of 30 patients (86.7%) achieved MM, and the median time to MM achievement was 8.0months. The time to MM was shorter in OMG than in GMG (log-rank P=0.044). In the phenotype-stratified Cox model, higher early tacrolimus trough concentration was associated with faster MM achievement (hazard ratio [HR] 1.38, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.15-1.66; P<0.001), whereas higher baseline Myasthenia Gravis Composite (MGC) score was associated with slower MM achievement (HR 0.81, 95% CI 0.70-0.92; P=0.002). Exploratory quartile-based curves showed a descriptive tendency toward earlier MM achievement in patients with higher early trough concentrations. Early tacrolimus trough concentration and baseline MGC were linked to the time to MM achievement under steroid-free tacrolimus monotherapy in AChR antibody-positive MG. These variables warrant prospective evaluation as early indicators for treatment reassessment.

items.title: Characterization of Patients Living with Generalized Myasthenia Gravis Initiating Rozanolixizumab in the USA.
items.authors: Minjee Park, Angela Ting, Aaksa Nair, Alexandria Harrold, Mohita Kumar
items.abstract: Rozanolixizumab is a neonatal fragment crystallizable receptor blocker approved to treat adults with anti-acetylcholine receptor (AChR) or anti-muscle-specific tyrosine kinase (MuSK) antibody-positive (Ab+) generalized myasthenia gravis (MG) in the USA. This retrospective, observational cohort study aimed to understand the profile of patients initiating rozanolixizumab treatment in the USA. Adults with MG who enrolled in a patient support program (ONWARD™) and/or had specialty pharmacy data were included. Descriptive analysis of de-identified data (July 2023-February 2025) was conducted to summarize patient, disease and treatment characteristics, rozanolixizumab use at baseline, and rozanolixizumab use patterns during follow-up. This study included 877 patients, of whom 51.5% were female. Mean (standard deviation [SD]) age was 62.2 (16.6) years; median (range) body weight was 87.0 (36-180) kg. Most patients had MG Foundation of America Clinical Class II or III (38.3% and 46.2%, respectively); 73.1% had anti-AChR Ab+ MG; 15.1% had anti-MuSK Ab+ MG. Baseline mean (SD) MG Activities of Daily Living score (n = 695) was 8.4 (3.8). Most patients (98.3%; n = 578/588) were naïve to rozanolixizumab. The mean (SD) follow-up for patients with ≥ 1 additional treatment date (n = 393) was 33.5 (19.1) weeks. Patients with ≥ 1 year of follow-up since rozanolixizumab initiation (n = 100) started a mean 3.7 cycles in year 1, comparable to the mean 4.1 cycles observed in Phase 3 studies. In the USA, rozanolixizumab treatment has been initiated in a broad population of patients with MG, with treatment patterns generally consistent with clinical trials.

items.title: Promoter CpG island hypomethylation and overexpression of molecules homologous to the muscle autoantigens acetylcholine receptor and ryanodine receptor in thymoma epithelial cells associated with myasthenia gravis.
items.authors: Yu Hong, Hai-Feng Li, Yanjun Guo, Lei Liu, Geir Olve Skeie, Jiawei Wang
items.abstract: Thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis (TAMG) represents the paraneoplastic subtype of MG and is characterized by autoantibodies against skeletal muscle proteins, such as acetylcholine receptor (AChR), titin, and ryanodine receptor (RyR). Thymic epithelial cells of TAMG patients overexpress neuronal and neuromuscular genes that code for MG autoantigen epitopes. This may contribute to the autoimmune breakdown in TAMG patients. This study explored whether such aberrant expression of autoimmune epitopes is regulated by their promoter CpG methylation profiles. The thymoma bulk RNA sequencing, single cell RNA sequencing, and DNA methylation data were collected from 40 TAMG and 96 non-MG thymoma patients using three independent cohorts. A novel algorithm using a multiple linear regression model was developed to examine the gene promoter CpG island methylation status in TAMG and non-thymoma MG patients. The correlation between promoter CpG island and RNA expression in the TAMG thymoma was explored. In both TAMG and non-MG thymoma, the global promoter CpG islands were hypomethylated and were negatively correlated with RNA expression. The CpG islands at promoters of muscle-like epitope genes, NEFM and RYR3, were significantly hypomethylated in TAMG thymoma and negatively correlated with mRNA expression in both a primary and a verification cohort. For MG antigen genes CHRNA1, TTN and RyR1, the CHRNA1 promoter CpG site methylation correlated negatively with CHRNA1 RNA expression. However, there was no difference in promoter methylation status between TAMG and non-MG thymomas. For the AIRE gene, the promoter CPG islands were significantly hypermethylated and negatively correlated with mRNA expression. Both bulk and single cell RNA sequencing showed that key genes involved in the DNA CpG methylation pathways, including DNMT1, UHRF1 and HDAC1, had a reduced expression in thymic epithelial cells of TAMG thymoma. Our results indicate that the aberrant overexpression of muscle-like epitopes in TAMG might be driven by CpG island hypomethylation. This represents a novel mechanism for intrathymic autoantigen regulation, relevant for the early pathogenesis of TAMG and thymoma-associated autoimmune disorders. Our findings should be verified in larger cohorts and with functional and histological validation.

items.title: Individualized sequencing of targeted immunotherapies in generalized myasthenia gravis across distinct patient profiles.
items.authors: Vasiliki Zouvelou, Dimitra Tzavella, Eleni Strataki, Aigli G Vakrakou
items.abstract: Targeted immunotherapies have expanded treatment options for acetylcholine receptor antibody-positive generalized myasthenia gravis (gMG), but evidence regarding their sequencing and individualized therapeutic pathways remains limited. We describe seven selected adults with AChR-positive gMG managed through individualized targeted-treatment pathways involving administered and, in some cases, planned sequential therapy. Treatment selection was guided by disease severity, corticosteroid-related risks, presence of thymoma, comorbidities, peripheral venous access and the need for rapid clinical improvement and/or sustained disease management. Across the seven cases, FcRn antagonists were used for rapid symptom control, corticosteroid dose reduction and bridging therapy while the appropriate vaccinations required before planned complement inhibition or B-cell depletion therapy were completed. Rituximab was selected as a long-term B-cell-directed immunosuppressive strategy, particularly in recent-onset gMG. Ravulizumab was planned as a long-term, non-steroidal immunosuppressive therapy in thymoma-associated myasthenia gravis and in chronic gMG with symptoms refractory to conventional non-steroidal immunosuppressive therapy and dependent on corticosteroids. These seven cases illustrate how targeted immunotherapies may be used sequentially and individualized according to their onset of action, MG subgroup, treatment goal, required vaccinations and route of administration.

items.title: Blueberry Muffin Sign: A Diagnostic Histochemical Clue in Mitochondrial Myopathy.
items.authors: Abraham Alhatou, Omar M Alhatou, Anwar I Joudeh, Mohammed Alhatou
items.abstract: Chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia (CPEO) is a rare manifestation of mitochondrial myopathy, marked by slowly progressive bilateral ptosis and ophthalmoplegia that can mimic other ocular myopathies, often leading to delayed diagnosis. We report a 63-year-old female with a 24-year history of slowly progressive bilateral ptosis, ophthalmoplegia, and proximal muscle weakness. Laboratory investigations, brain and orbital magnetic resonance imaging, and extensive genetic testing were unrevealing, and she did not respond to empirical treatment for presumed myasthenia gravis. Muscle biopsy demonstrated ragged red fibers, increased succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity, and cytochrome c oxidase (COX)-deficient fibers appearing intensely blue on combined SDH/COX staining, a pattern the authors term the "Blueberry Muffin Sign." Electron microscopy confirmed paracrystalline "parking lot" inclusions, supporting a diagnosis of CPEO due to mitochondrial myopathy. The "Blueberry Muffin Sign" on combined COX-SDH histochemical staining represents a potentially useful diagnostic clue for mitochondrial myopathy that may facilitate earlier recognition of CPEO, particularly when genetic testing is inconclusive; validation in larger, genetically characterized cohorts is needed to establish its diagnostic specificity and reproducibility.

items.title: Pregnancy in Autoimmune Polyglandular Syndrome Type 3c With Graves' Disease and Myasthenia Gravis: A Case Report.
items.authors: Miguel Angel Salazar Perez, Maria Fernanda Borbon Reyna, Karen Vanessa Betancourt Padilla, Martin Alejandro Pamanes de la Fuente, Jesus Jaquez Domínguez
items.abstract: Autoimmune polyglandular syndrome type 3c (APS3c), characterized by autoimmune thyroid disease with another organ-specific autoimmune disorder in the absence of adrenal insufficiency, is an uncommon presentation. Its coexistence with Graves' disease and myasthenia gravis (MG) is rare and poses additional diagnostic and therapeutic challenges, particularly when complicated by thyroid storm and pregnancy. We report the ongoing management of a 22-year-old woman with this combination of autoimmune disorders. She was admitted with thyroid storm diagnosed using the Burch-Wartofsky Point Scale and Japan Thyroid Association criteria after a 15-month history of weight loss, heat intolerance, diaphoresis, anxiety, palpitations, unilateral ptosis, and fatigable proximal upper-extremity weakness. Graves' disease and MG were diagnosed based on clinical findings, positive thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulin and acetylcholine receptor antibodies, and electrophysiological evidence of a postsynaptic neuromuscular junction disorder. In the absence of clinical or biochemical evidence of primary adrenal insufficiency, the coexistence of autoimmune thyroid disease and MG supported a diagnosis of APS3c on the Neufeld and Blizzard classification. Despite methimazole (15 mg/day) and pyridostigmine (600 mg/day) therapy, and good adherence to treatment, biochemical hyperthyroidism persisted and progressed to thyroid storm. During outpatient follow-up, an intrauterine pregnancy was confirmed. Methimazole was withheld during the first trimester while the patient remained clinically stable despite persistent biochemical hyperthyroidism, and it was resumed thereafter. At the time of writing, the pregnancy remains ongoing under multidisciplinary care involving endocrinology, neurology, internal medicine, and maternal-fetal medicine, with serial maternal monitoring, planned third-trimester antibody reassessment, targeted fetal ultrasonography, perinatal planning, and neonatal surveillance. This case highlights APS3c as an important diagnostic framework for the coexistence of Graves' disease and MG and illustrates how management must be continually reassessed in the setting of thyroid storm and pregnancy. Maternal, fetal, and neonatal outcomes remain pending.

items.title: Good's syndrome and infections in a large retrospective cohort of thymoma.
items.authors: Wenji Jia, Lei Jin, Xiao Huan, Chong Yan, Jianying Xi, Liewen Pang, Chongbo Zhao, Jie Song, Xianglin Chu, Sushan Luo
items.abstract: Good's syndrome (GS) is an immunodeficiency associated with thymoma characterized by hypogammaglobulinemia. The co-existence of recurrent infections may be associated with quality of life and overall survival. Despite its relevance, the impact of GS on patients with thymoma has rarely been studied in large cohorts. This is a retrospective cohort study of patients with pathologically confirmed thymoma recruited between May 2010 and November 2024. Data on peripheral immune profile, infections, and paraneoplastic syndrome (PNS) were collected and analyzed. Of 1001 patients with thymoma, we ultimately included 158 patients who underwent peripheral immune profiling. The prevalence of GS was 45.6% (72/158), and the infections were reported in 43.69% (69/158). Infection rates were higher in the GS group than in non-GS group (50% versus 32.72%, P = 0.0384). Among the 121 pathogens identified from this cohort, bacteria were the most prevalent (52.07%, 63/121), followed by fungi (34.71%, 42/121) and virus (13.22%, 16/121). Patients with infections had significantly lower overall survival compared with those without infections (P < 0.001). In addition, patients with multiple PNS had poorer survival than those with a single PNS (P < 0.001). No significant difference in overall survival was found between the GS and the non-GS groups. GS and infections are prevalent in patients with thymoma. Infections and multiple PNS were associated with poorer survival outcomes. These findings highlight the importance of early detection and intervention for improving prognosis and long-term survival in patients with thymoma.
